identification.summary: TOXIC PANDA appears in Malpedia as an actor name whose one-line description is a group targeting dissident groups in China and at its boundaries, sourced to a 2014 RSA Conference session titled The Art of Attribution [S1][S2]. No vendor report dedicated to this actor was found in open search, so the profile rests on that single descriptive line [S1].
identification.notes: The PANDA suffix follows CrowdStrike's naming convention, but no CrowdStrike adversary page for TOXIC PANDA was found; do not assume CrowdStrike authorship of the description beyond the RSA session listing [S1]. Name collision: the Android banking trojan ToxicPanda (Cleafy, 2024) is a separate, financially motivated malware family assessed by Cleafy as likely operated by Chinese speakers and related to TgToxic [S3]. There is no source linking it to the 2014 TOXIC PANDA actor name; the two must not be merged.

targeting.notes: The only sourced targeting statement is dissident groups in China and at its boundaries [S1]. No sectors, regions or victims were found.

diamond.victim: Dissident groups in China and at its boundaries [S1].

gaps: No dedicated vendor report, malware, infrastructure, campaign dates or ATT&CK mapping for TOXIC PANDA was found; the profile is a single descriptive line from a 2014 conference listing.

The 2014 RSA slide deck (docs.huihoo.com mirror) and the Malpedia page could not be fetched in this environment (host resolution failure), so the underlying text was seen only through search-result summaries [S1][S2].
State sponsor, confidence and Microsoft mapping are unknown; the record's country value CN is carried from the import and is not independently supported here.
Possible overlap with other PANDA-named or Malpedia-listed clusters is unverified.
Whether TOXIC PANDA relates to the 2024 ToxicPanda Android banking trojan is unsupported; treated as name collision only [S3].
